displayName: ヨルノシルベ Sky / Moon / Resolution Color Script Master
purpose: Keep sky, stars, moon state and resolution presentation consistent with Current world rules without turning the moon into a clock, inventing a physical sunrise, or forcing one identical astronomical sky across eras.

stateGraph.notes: Baseline sky must still read as the same project world; do not force one universal moon phase or one identical constellation arrangement across every era.
Moon change is semantic depth, not elapsed hours and not a five-step boss meter.
Moonless does not mean starless, physical dawn is not automatically next, and no fixed era Boss is implied.
Resolution may change emotional read, but this Master does not invent a specific brighter palette, sunrise gradient, moon return, or astronomical explanation.
Return occurs by waking to each person's Reality era, not by waiting for physical morning.

eraAndConstellationRules: Do not force all eras to display identical constellation membership or historical line figures.
Modern IAU88 project line-art is a separate stable modern reference system, not proof that old Dream skies used the same historical figures.
Historical constellation evidence and lost/added constellations remain separate archive/reference layers.
Do not use a modern zodiac-glyph wallpaper as a substitute for actual constellation/world logic.
Do not turn constellation change into Canon cause until the final cause is authorized.
colorScriptRules: Use relative state labels before exact HEX when Story authority has not fixed exact palette.
Moonless depth may darken composition but must preserve star readability and useful scene readability.
Resolution treatment may re-balance contrast, atmosphere or local light, but may not imply physical sunrise unless authority changes.
Do not make every Boss scene use the same black-purple grade.
Do not make every resolved scene use the same gold-orange dawn grade.
Character body/skin/fur/shell identity colors remain governed by Character production authorities rather than this sky script.
